AccessToken.name: Authorization
AccessToken.description: Access key sent in the Authorization header as `Token <access_key>`

accesstoken.title: Access Token
accesstoken.description: Access Tokens represent a fixed level of access to the platform for a specific user

user_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the user an access token is associated with.

account_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the account an access token is associated with.

enterprise_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the enterprise an access token is associated with.

expire_at.description: Date value at which time the access token will be invalidated.

name.description: A user friendly name for a specific access token.

trailer.description: The tail end of the access key. For display and easy identification

type.description: Denotes the intended usage of the access token.

token_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the access token.

roles.description: A list of role identifiers to grant to the access token

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the token was originally created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the token was last altered in some way

last_used_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the token was last used to authenticate a request.

auth-account.title: Account
auth-account.description:
Represents a platform level account used for
registration, authentication and authorization.

account.description: A shorthand identifier for the associated account

company.description: Name of the company which owns the account

deactivated.description: Timestamp of when the account was deactivated, or null when active

plan.description: Billing plan and associated feature information pertaining to the account

status.description: Indication the account's current activation state

quota.description: Quota information pertaining to the account

retention.description: Data retention policy information pertaining to the account

created.description: Indicates when the account was created

meta.description: Metadata about the account

permissions.title: Permission list to be specified in responses body
permissions.description:
Permissions represent the set of resources a particular
entity has access to.

permissions-request.title: Permission list to be specified in requests body
permissions-request.description:
Permissions represent the set of resources a particular
entity has access to.

auth-role.title: Role
auth-role.description: Roles represent a set of permissions to resources which applying to a user or an access token

role_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the role.

account_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the account a role is associated with.

name.description: A user friendly name for a specific role.

slug.description: A role unique code generated automatically from role name

system.description: Indicator if a role is managed by the Mezmo platform

internal.description: Indicator that a role is strictly for use by internal platform processes

items.description: A parent role id which permissions will be inherited

context_filter.description:
Users belonging to this role will have the queries found in this field
applied as additional filters to search queries they perform to constrain
the data they have access to.

items.description: Search query to be applied as additional pre-filters when searching logs

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the role was originally created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the role was last altered in some way

service-account.title: Service Account
service-account.description:
A service account is a special type of account intended to represent a
non-human user that needs to authenticate and be authorized to access data in APIs.

service_account_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the service account.

account_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the account a service account is associated with.

enterprise_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the enterprise a service account is associated with.

token_id.description: A value that uniquely identifies the service account access token.

name.description: A user friendly, name for a service account.

expire_after.description: The number of days after which tokens issued by a service account will expire.

description.description: Additional information to provide further context around the use cases for the service account.
description.example: Used for provisioning pipelines via terraform

roles.description: A list of role identifiers to grant to the service account

agent_id.description: The unique identifier of the active agent this service account is associated with, or null when not currently assigned to an agent.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the service account was originally created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp indicating the moment the service account was last altered in some way

user.title: User
user.description:
Represents an individual human and is used in
registration, authentication and authorization.

user_id.description: Unique identifier which can be used to reference a specific user.

firstname.description: Name of user given to them upon birth.

lastname.description: Common family or surname of the user.

email.description:
Used primarily as a means of authentication during login.
Additionally, this is the address where platform emails intended for the user
will be sent.

name.description: Full name of the user. Generally the combination of firstname and lastname.

accounts.description:
List of short account id which indicate all accounts
under which a user is a member of.

enterprise_ids.description:
List of ids which indicate all enterprise accounts
under which a user is a member of.

verified.description:
Indication of whether the user has completed the registration process
and confirmed to be a legitimate person.

isbanned.description: Indication if the user has been restricted from using the platform.

bandetails.description: Additional contextual information as to why the user was banned.

bannedat.description: Timestamp of when the ban was initially issued.

banreason.description: Primary motivation behind initially issuing the ban

name.description: Name of the user who issued the original ban.

email.description: Email address of the user who issued the original ban.

roles.description: A list of role identifiers which granted to the user
